reviewed_scope: Original 16 native corpus + 10 Homebrew SQLite 3.54.0 functions; retained default and raised-budget evidence; analysis only

baseline.excluded: Project databases, dependency/bridge checkouts, virtualenvs, native source checkout and installed tools; duplicate wire/stdout streams, Open Decomp numbered warm responses (timings/states/cache in aggregate results retained), image census page bodies and raw-control/census per-call duplicates. All three default projects first selected decompile raw responses and C, raised raw responses/full artifacts/C, Ghidra all repeated raw responses in results.json retained. Original raw bytes/historical local paths retained; no environment-variable dumps.

source.license: SQLite public domain / blessing; https://sqlite.org/copyright.html. Linked system/readline components separate; see retained SBOM and recipe.
source.compiler: clang per Homebrew INSTALL_RECEIPT.json; precise version unavailable in retained bottle receipt
source.flags_status: Recipe CPPFLAGS/configure options retained verbatim; full expanded compiler invocation/optimization flags were not recorded for this prebuilt bottle. Not claimed source-rebuild reproducible.
source.binary_origin: Homebrew sqlite 3.54.0 arm64 bottle, /opt/homebrew/Cellar/sqlite/3.54.0/bin/sqlite3; copied, not executed

method.client: Same Python stdlib newline JSON-RPC client for both real MCP servers; no SDK advertised-schema validation. Historical baseline OD used official SDK, so new timings are not directly the same method.
method.timing: perf_counter before wire send/logging through matching parsed JSON-RPC response; includes transport/raw logging, excludes subsequent numbered JSON serialization; request boundary samples only, not isolated engine time.
method.repeated: Existing server/analyzed project; Open Decomp may serve published cached results, pinned Ghidra bridge creates/disposes DecompInterface each call. Not persistent-interface engine comparison.
method.semantic_state: Open Decomp operation envelope and full artifact state recorded separately; complete is not equivalence. Ghidra bridge does not report semantic coverage; text/truncation is not correctness.
method.claims: Harness retention and smoke only, not comparative wins, cross-architecture parity, readability scoring, behavioral validation, or full corpus evaluation.
method.raised_profile: Separate explicitly raised profile; full selected set per-operation budgets, not a replay of historical supplemental failed-only 300-second/input schedule. Never pool default/raised timings.
method.output_location: Use a non-hidden durable output directory: pinned Ghidra/pyghidra rejects dot-prefixed project location elements (.local observed). Preparation can use .local/performance.

gaps: Only symbol-bearing Mach-O ARM64 is reviewed here; no stripped/PE/ELF/other optimization/compiler or held-out evaluation.
Exact expanded Homebrew compiler invocation unavailable; preserve honest recipe/receipt evidence, not guessed flags.
Baseline application bundle source revision not recorded; retained entry hash/component versions/raw tools identify observation, not byte-rebuild provenance.
No reused persistent Ghidra DecompInterface comparison, repeated-run distribution report or isolated engine/transport/RSS measurements implemented by this harness item.
